name: Farmer
description: Grows things on purpose and is modest about it. Knows the weather before the weather does.
hint: Good soil, early mornings, and something green coming up. All it wants is someone to tend the ground.

name: Hunter
description: Knows every track in the woods and most of the animals by name. Mostly brings back mushrooms and stories.
hint: A quiet step and a patient eye. The animals have noticed you noticing them.

name: Carpenter
description: Measures twice, cuts once, and talks to the timber the whole time. The chairs come out sturdy and a little smug.
hint: Sawdust, a sharp pencil, and a tree with potential.

name: Blacksmith
description: Warm iron, a steady hammer, and horseshoes for an unreasonable number of dragons. The dragons are particular about fit.
hint: A hot forge and someone willing to stand next to it. Bring an apron.

name: Herbalist
description: Knows which leaf settles a stomach and which one starts a sneeze. Labels both, in very small handwriting.
hint: Small green things, picked at the right moment. Someone ought to know what they are all for.

name: Merchant
description: Buys, sells, and remembers how you take your tea. The scales are honest and the smile is extra.
hint: A little silver and a talent for conversation. There is a stall waiting somewhere.

name: Scribe
description: Ink to the wrist and a stamp for every occasion. Nothing has properly happened until a scribe has written it down.
hint: A good quill and tidy handwriting. Somewhere, a form needs filling in.

name: Soldier
description: Guards the farm, walks the fences, and finds the lost sheep. The armor is mostly for the rain.
hint: A sturdy sort, handed a bit of iron and told to look reliable.

name: Spy
description: Nobody's cousin and everybody's friend. Knows whose pie won the fair before the judges do.
hint: Someone who likes the shade and listens well. Curtains are involved.

name: Tea Shop Owner
description: Keeps the kettle on and the gossip warm. Has never once let a customer leave sad.
hint: A warm room, a good kettle, and the sense that you could fix anyone's day. Some brews require a license from the local tea authority. Not yet.

name: Innkeeper
description: Keeps a fire, a full barrel, and a spare bed. Knows everybody's usual and most of their business.
hint: A steady hand for pouring and a good ear for listening. The town wants somewhere to sit down.

name: Wizard
description: Owns a book, a hat, and a license in a frame. Mostly asked to find lost cats and warm the soup.
hint: A person, a book, and a slightly worrying amount of curiosity. The hat comes later.

name: Alchemist
description: Stained fingers and a shelf of labeled jars. Turns weeds into remedies and, on off days, into something that hums.
hint: A gatherer of herbs starts wondering what else they could become. Things begin to bubble.

name: Runesmith
description: Writes words into warm iron so the kettle remembers how you like it. Spelling counts.
hint: A smith who has learned to read, and has things to say. The iron is listening.

name: Enchanter
description: Tucks a small spell into an ordinary thing and hands it back improved. The broom now sweeps on its own and has opinions about corners.
hint: A wizard, a bit of crystal, and a spell that wants somewhere to live.

name: Battle Mage
description: Keeps the watch fires lit and the rain off the parade. Can do rather more, and is hardly ever asked.
hint: A soldier is shown where the fire comes from. The cooking improves at once.

name: Court Mage
description: Stands a step behind the fancy chair and keeps the candles even. Advises on weather, banquets, and which hat.
hint: A wizard gets a little too close to a crown. There will be banquets.

name: Hermit Wizard
description: Moved to the woods with a book and a kettle. Receives visitors gladly, about twice a year.
hint: A wizard, some wilderness, and a strong preference for quiet.

name: Necromancer
description: Tends the old graves and takes tea with the ghosts, who are very polite. Keeps odd hours and excellent records.
hint: A wizard takes an interest in what comes after. The ghosts are pleased to have company.

name: Healer
description: Mends scrapes, settles fevers, and prescribes soup. The bandages are warm from the windowsill.
hint: Someone who knows their herbs learns a spell for mending. Soup will be prescribed.

name: Magical Scholar
description: Has read every spell and cast almost none. Can tell you exactly why it works, at length.
hint: A scribe starts reading what they are copying. The library gains a regular.

name: Professor
description: Teaches the next lot, loses the chalk daily, and is secretly proud of every one of them.
hint: A scholar is given someone to teach. Chalk dust is in their future.

name: Back-Room Apothecary
description: Sells tonics from under the counter, all of them definitely legal. The hiccup elixir is the best in town and has no label.
hint: An alchemist discovers the shady side of the street. Business is brisk and the paperwork is, ah, pending.
